verdict.stance: Constructive / Romania's #1 Bank Building Deep MREL Buffers (BBB Neg / Baa2)
verdict.summary: Romania's largest lender delivered 9M26 group net profit of RON 3.8bn (+18% YoY), +17% operating income growth, 238% LCR, ~21.5% CAR, and ~2.8% NPLs. BT raised €1bn Senior Preferred 2032s (Apr-26) and €500m Tier 2 (Sep-26), building robust MREL/subordination cushions ahead of sovereign fiscal noise (Fitch BBB Negative).

positives: Undisputed #1 Romanian banking franchise (>20% market share) posting +18% YoY 9M26 net profit (RON 3.8bn).
Exceptional 238% LCR liquidity and ~21.5% CAR bolstered by €500m Tier 2 (Sep-26) and €600m AT1 (Nov-25).
Strong organic earnings generation absorbs OTP Romania integration.
negatives: Fitch BBB Negative outlook reflects direct linkage to Romania's sovereign fiscal deficit trajectory.
Bank turnover tax in Romania compresses net margin efficiency.
Rising EUR wholesale MREL issuance increases foreign-currency interest expense.

background.business_overview: Romania's largest commercial bank serving retail, SME, corporate, and microbusiness segments.
background.asset_perimeter: Banca Transilvania standalone + OTP Bank Romania integration + Victoriabank (Moldova).
background.ownership_governance: Widely held on Bucharest Stock Exchange (TLV); EBRD strategic shareholder.
